title: A Job in the Sun
lines: Jin and Mom are in the hot fog.
A jet is up in the sun.
Jin has a jug and a mug.
Jin tugs and tugs. The jug is in the fog.
"Do not tug at the jug," said Mom.
Jin dips the mug in the jug.
Jin and Mom sit and look at the jet.
scoring_note: This passage says "i am", "do not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "I'm" or "don't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
